title: allow read-only reviewers to run go test with -renders into their own temp dir so they can inspect render fixtures

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-131038-69e9, project ork, item S499:

allow read-only reviewers to run go test with -renders into their own temp dir so they can inspect render fixtures

Evidence: the go test -run ^TestRenderCLIViews$ -renders TEMPDIR -render-fixture ... command was denied with "This command can't be checked before it runs"
